title: Presentation Spec Generalization
description: Align @framework/presentation with the spec: introduce Slide (arrangement + optional transition), generalize Morph with auto-derived bridge slides, simplify Split to tiles only, remove bespoke column/ghost/morphTarget machinery, update renderer and 33.projektetage deck.
summary: Removed the derived catalogue-labels bridge slide: positioned figure-crop morph slots now morph directly into positioned text labels in one reveal.js step (`morphBridgeDirect`). Dormant crop anchors no longer set inline opacity so they stay visible as morph sources when leaving Bauteilarten. v=14 is now Bauteilbeschriftungen text. Core/renderer/deck tests updated (30/19/6 passing).
